title: The Moss Shrine
text: A shrine sleeps under a coat of moss. Someone left an offering bowl of Ember Shards, and a candle that has never been lit.

choices.label: Light the candle from the Ember

outcomes.text: The candle catches. Something in the moss stirs and leaves a gift.
The flame gutters. The Ember shrinks back, sulking.
Nobody stops you. Nobody had to.
The shards are cold. So, now, are your hands.
Mira nods. "Some things are better left sleeping."

title: The Buried Wagon
text: A wagon's ribs poke from the sand, its canvas bleached white. A caravan like yours, once.

outcomes.text: A strongbox, still sealed.
Something else was living in it.
A few loose shards and a dented flask.

choices.label: Say a word for them and move on

outcomes.text: Oren speaks the hearth-rite. The party feels steadier.

title: The Mirage Market
text: Stalls shimmer between two dunes. The merchant has no face, only a smile. "Everything here costs a little of you."

outcomes.text: The smile widens. You leave with something real.
A fair trade, against all odds.
The market melts into haze, and your shards with it.
Kit looks back once. The stalls are already gone.

title: The Frozen Pilgrim
text: A pilgrim stands frozen mid-step, a dark lantern in one hand. The ice around the lantern is thinner, as if it remembers warmth.

outcomes.text: The lantern flickers once. The pilgrim does not wake, but the party learns something.
It comes free with a crack of ice.
The pilgrim turns its head.
Lysa keeps her eyes on the road.

title: The Ember Whispers
text: At the night fire the Ember crackles in a rhythm almost like words. Mira has gone very still.

outcomes.text: It shows you a way to fight you had not seen.
It shows you too much. Your legs are heavy for days.
The Ember drinks the shards and glows like noon. Everyone sleeps well.
"It says keep moving," she says, and won't say more.

title: The Ash Choir
text: In a ruined chapel, figures of ash sing a hymn for a city that is gone. Their song is beautiful and very cold.

outcomes.text: For one verse, Solenne is alive again.
The cold gets into your voice and stays.
The hymn breaks into a scream.

choices.label: Hold the Ember up to them

outcomes.text: The ash remembers fire and falls gently to the floor, at peace.
They turn toward the light, hungry.
